Name: Hazelwoods Glade Farm
Author: loafeon
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n4XdwZb.png[/img]

﻿[list]
[*][size=2]Start out with [b]2 Bee Houses[/b] & [b]2 Garden Pots[/b]![/size]
[*][size=2]Catch Mountain, Town, and Forest fish[/size]
[*][size=2]Enjoy a foraging island, quarry, and secret cave![/size]
[*][size=2]Look around & you may discover a few spring onions[/size]
[*][size=2]Play separate co-op with 1 friend![/size]
[*][size=2]Special farmhouse furniture layout[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ad9prRZ.png[/img]

﻿
[list]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13804]Custom Farm Loader[/url]﻿ [/size]
[*][size=2]Extract mod into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[i]*I suggest utilizing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16873]Easy Farm Switcher[/url] for prior save files*[/i]
[/size]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hxvaHeU.png[/img]
